name: Maestro Router 2 unvalidated external call
summary: Maestro Router 2 implementation 0x8eae9827b45bcc6570c4e82b9e4fe76692b2ff7a exposed function 0x9239127f without caller authorization or target/calldata constraints. Through the proxy, an unprivileged caller could make the router execute token transferFrom calls as the spender and remove tokens from users who had approved the router.
notes: The proxy's creation transaction emitted its sole pre-incident Upgraded event at log 212, selecting implementation 0x8eae9827b45bcc6570c4e82b9e4fe76692b2ff7a in topic1. The implementation slot reads that address after deployment and immediately before the exploit. The implementation runtime was independently deployed 180 seconds earlier in transaction 0xb9f410053228bc6b25aa0fe513550d11c61e7d66d451f7e07ed193bb0d261805 and hashes to 0x037e8031318a63c3d7212fb95b4ba28d279dc57ec5c0423ad22f4c9acf509447 at deployment and pre-exploit. No later pre-incident Upgraded event exists.

The 12 successful campaign receipts show exactly 270.505159823556961290 WETH transferred from liquidation pools to the attack helper and immediately withdrawn to ETH. This is the exact common-asset value realized from the stolen tokens before any recovery, rather than the rounded 280-ETH public estimate. It is recorded as net loss because the gross victim depletion comprised 11 different volatile or illiquid tokens; separately adding those token quantities to their sale proceeds would double count the same loss. Receipt logs establish exact stolen quantities of 565463522794.182597666471533996 MOG, 48547556.581675106888722181 LMI, 36699014.396393139889031068 JOE, 9347.142332543648356945 BANANA, 4988293193.069537666 OGGY, 210000848.249795702514222702 jim, 240800.995682007751449462 ETF, 16597.430949033 LP, 6444188221.913920492320455870 APU, 102061241.618795802640566220 шайлушай, and 10685.567762358287885017 PROPHET. PROPHET_Dividends mirror-transfer logs are accounting shares and are not a twelfth asset. Later Maestro reimbursements do not reduce this pre-recovery measurement. DefiLlama's nearest WETH observation was $1,782.36 at 2023-10-24T23:30:00Z, 59 seconds before campaign end.
The defect-bearing implementation was not source-verified; root-cause review relies on execution traces, bytecode/decompiled analysis, and independent incident reporting.
